notes: The battery pack and motors have fixed attached leads (red/black), so no separate jumper wires are used; leads are clamped directly in the screw terminals.
Battery red -> VIN, black -> GND, as required by the manual. Motors may go either way round; the assignment of motor wires to terminal lugs is arbitrary.
Battery pack is a 4-cell AA holder with an ON/OFF switch (not in catalogue); a new type was created. Switch must be OFF while wiring.

Motor controller board is a new type; the board plugs onto the Pi GPIO header and uses GPIO 7, 8, 9, 10. The exact mapping of each GPIO to motor terminals (through pairs) is an assumption; the board is modelled with the header pins it uses plus one ground pin (GND.5, pin 25, assumed).
Powering the Pi itself (USB supply) is mentioned only as 'power up' and is not modelled.
